# The Commons

The Commons is an open library and match-maker of agent-readable ML
experiment evidence. It is the third layer of PI Lab's three-layer system:
`pcq` is the Apache-2.0 evidence contract, `cq` is the press that produces
and ships evidence, and The Commons keeps that evidence — and tells you
which experiment to read next.

The Commons does not run experiments. It is a stateless advisor: `cq` holds
the experiment-cycle state and calls The Commons for retrieval and
recommendation. The Commons preserves, classifies, and ranks evidence, then
answers "this problem + these resources -> recommended recipe, with reasons".

Core identity:

- Raw evidence is the knowledge unit, not a prose summary. The pcq run
  record itself is what gets stored and retrieved.
- Negative and failed results are first-class. "What did not work" narrows
  the search space as much as what did.
- Synthetic evidence is a seed, not a destination. LLM-distilled evidence
  solves cold start and auto-retires once real evidence accumulates per
  cluster.
- Contribution is membership. A reciprocity loop, not a one-way feed; one
  contributor's evidence measurably shifts another contributor's
  recommendation.
- It is not AutoML. AutoML only sees your own data and your own runs. The
  Commons plans your next experiment from other users' evidence, and your
  result re-enters the next person's recommendation — a cross-user
  match-maker for ML experiments.

Status: v0.1 — code-level stabilization complete (10-cycle review, 22
fixes, 242 tests). Phase 1 is internal only, reachable through `cq`.
Production deployment and the 3-month vision verdict are still pending.

Canonical resources:

- Project page: https://playidea-lab.github.io/TC/
- Repository: https://github.com/playidea-lab/TC
- Vision document (README): https://github.com/playidea-lab/TC/blob/main/README.md
- pcq input contract (vendored): https://playidea-lab.github.io/TC/pcq-2.x.md
- Machine manifest: https://playidea-lab.github.io/TC/agent-manifest.json

Match-maker architecture (Hybrid retrieve-and-rerank):

1. Natural-language serialization — the pcq evidence record is rendered to
   a template-versioned natural-language description (template_version).
2. Embedding — Gemini Embedding 2, Matryoshka-truncated to 1024 dimensions.
3. Retrieve — PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector, HNSW cosine, top-K (default 20).
4. Rerank — Gemini 2.5 Flash, listwise, returns top-N (default 5) with
   stated reasons.

Every vendor seam is a Protocol — EmbeddingProvider, LLMReranker,
VectorIndex, EvidenceStore, ReciprocityEventStore, RetirementBackend — so
the embedding/LLM/store vendor can be swapped without touching callers.

HTTP surface (Phase 1, internal, via cq):

```
GET  /health          liveness (process is up)
GET  /ready           readiness (database reachable)
POST /ingest          pcq 2.x evidence -> validate, embed, store, promote/contradict
GET  /evidence        filtered, paginated search
GET  /evidence/{id}   L1 immutable record (verifier is server-derived, not stored)
POST /recommend       Hybrid retrieve-and-rerank -> recipe + reasons
GET  /verdict          3-event vision-metric status
GET  /metrics          cost and event operational visibility
```

Evidence model:

- L1 immutable — the stored run record never changes.
- L2 append-only — lineage and reciprocity events accrete, never overwrite.
- L3 mutable visibility — synthetic-vs-real status and retirement are the
  only mutable surface.
- PHI is auto-blocked at ingestion. The verifier identity is derived
  server-side at read time (a JOIN), never stored on the record.

3-event vision verdict (success is defined by behavior, not signups):

- Loop closure — one contributor's evidence measurably influences another
  contributor's recommendation.
- Synthetic retirement — accumulated real evidence auto-retires synthetic
  for a cluster.
- Verification by reproduction — a user's reproduction promotes or
  contradicts a record.

All three within 3 months -> success; 1-2 -> partial; 0 -> failure (vision
re-examined). One or more events of external origin -> strengthened
success. Current: not yet deployed — pre-measurement.

Tech stack:

- Python 3.12, FastAPI, Pydantic 2, uv.
- PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (HNSW, 1024-dim).
- Gemini Embedding 2 (embed) + Gemini 2.5 Flash (listwise rerank).
- structlog JSON logging, request-id middleware, token-bucket rate limit,
  Gemini daily cost ceiling, body-size limit, OWASP baseline headers.

Agent rule:

The Commons reports facts and ranked candidates with reasons; the calling
agent or service chooses policy. Prefer /recommend with explicit problem +
resource constraints over free-text. Negatives in the result set are
signal, not noise.
